outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches the door and raises it toward the oven during frames 55–73 in image and left_ego_image, with the door also entering wrist_image. By frame 74 the door is upright against the oven front; it remains closed as the robot withdraws through frame 109. No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
